classification.difficultyReason: Link numerical tables, sketches and case-defined equations; locate the shifted sign boundary in part c and interpret two restricted quadratic branches in part d. The stem supplies the method, so these are routine linked representations.

content.prompt: Sketch each graph by drawing up a table of values for $-3\le x\le3$. Then use cases to determine the equation of each branch of the function.

spec.description: Horizontal negative-x branch and rising positive-x branch; dashed guides mark (1,2).
spec.mathematics: y=0 for x<0; y=2x for x>=0.

spec.description: Descending left ray and horizontal positive-x branch; guides mark (-1,2).
spec.mathematics: y=-2x for x<0; y=0 for x>=0.

spec.description: Two increasing branches meet at (-1,0); guides mark (-2,-3), and the y-intercept is 1.
spec.mathematics: y=3x+3 for x<-1; y=x+1 for x>=-1.

spec.description: Two upward parabolic branches joined at the origin, with x-intercepts -2 and 2 and both minima labelled correctly.
spec.mathematics: Left branch (x+1)^2-1; right branch (x-1)^2-1. Teacher coordinate (1,1) corrected to (1,-1).
